steps.code:
# Parse the note content into song titles and artists
songs = []
for line in lines:
    # Split on " by " to separate title and artist part
    parts = line.split(' by ')
    if len(parts) == 2:
        title = parts[0].strip()
        artist_part = parts[1].strip()
        # Split artists by comma
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artist_part.split(',')]
        songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists})
    else:
        # If no " by ", maybe just title? But all have " by "
        songs.append({'title': line.strip(), 'artists': []})

print(songs)

# Let's find the song IDs for each song by searching and matching title and artists
playlist_id = create_playlist_response['playlist_id']

def find_song_id(title, artists):
    # Search for the song by title
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=title, access_token=spotify_token, page_limit=20)
    for song in results:
        if song['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            # Check if all artists match
            song_artists = [artist['name'].lower() for artist in song['artists']]
            expected_artists = [a.lower() for a in artists]
            if set(expected_artists) == set(song_artists):
                return song['song_id']
    return None

# Test for first song
song_id = find_song_id(songs[0]['title'], songs[0]['artists'])
print(song_id)
